exports.name: KbAntShell
exports.summary: Workspace with independent content scrolling, optional controlled desktop collapse, mobile Drawer, navigation skeleton. Props: appName, navigation [{path,label,group,icon}], navigationLoading=false, activePath, collapsed=false. Events: navigate(path), update:collapsed(boolean). Slots: default, actions({collapsed,toggle}), navigation({collapsed}). Route changes reset the actual main scroller.

exports.name: KbAntIcon
exports.summary: Native Ant icon. Props: name (UserOutlined or reload-outlined; Shell semantic aliases also supported), size=1em, spin=false, twoToneColor. Render through AButton #icon; label icon-only controls. Unknown names show QuestionCircleOutlined with data-icon-missing. See runtime/icons.md.

exports.name: antIcons
exports.summary: Complete pinned @ant-design/icons-vue namespace. Import { antIcons } from /antdv.js and locally register antIcons.UserOutlined etc. See runtime/icons.md.

exports.name: KbLucideIcon
exports.summary: Compatibility Lucide icon using the native .anticon container for Button spacing. Props: name (kebab-case, required), size=1em. Prefer KbAntIcon for native Ant style; use Button #icon and label icon-only controls.

exports.name: antZhCN
exports.summary: Chinese ConfigProvider locale object. Pass :locale="antZhCN". Set dayjs.locale("zh-cn") separately for date text.

exports.name: antEnUS
exports.summary: English ConfigProvider locale object. Set dayjs.locale("en") separately for date text.

exports.name: dayjs
exports.summary: Pinned Day.js 1.11.13 factory. Default date-picker values are Dayjs objects; prefer valueFormat="YYYY-MM-DD" for plain API strings. Display format does not define serialization.

exports.name: theme
exports.summary: Native theme.useToken() in setup; ConfigProvider theme={token:{colorPrimary},algorithm:theme.darkAlgorithm} controls component styling. Static message/notification/Modal methods do not inherit component context; use AApp.useApp() in a descendant of AApp when context is required.
